replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Thanks for the feed back - Download the map and you will see that it is not small at all. :) Also, look at all the great maps that others posted as the top 5 maps they like and you will see almost all of them are wanting simple maps that are game play rich where they can get to the fight. The monuments seem simple to get to, but spawn is 10 sec behind the monuments - this means that ALL players will be in a direct path to the monuments unlike most other maps - that is why the monuments are a little easier to access because most monuments will have more reinforcements directly and not rely on the Void as the primary defense.. As for the middle being to small, that is your opinion, but as the middle is only 14 blocks from either side - that makes the void very small, so a larger middle was not the correct choice in my opinion when placing 14 blocks is all you need to do. Also the Monuments can be guarded by players in the middle section of their plane - if they are good with a bow, again, reasons the monuments are where they are. :) thanks for the thoughts. - Great feed back! - As for spawn camping, I see that very little in Matches where Iron is in front of the spawn - like this one, also the no build area is a little bigger to prevent spawn blocking before either team has access to the iron. Also, if one team is so strong that they can push the other team back to spawn ( as it is located behind the monuments) and keep them there - the match is over and would not be fun for the other team so the monuments would be broken at that point as a choice would be made as to break monuments vs Spawn Camp and someone is going to break the monuments. We have all seen matches that last under 5 min and seen matches that last over an hour, My goal was for this to be about a 30 min match. -again  These are just my opinions - no one will know until its played - but thanks for all the info - you could be correct walrus hehe as your a nebula master :)
